description: Hărți Electronice de Navigație is a dataset listed in data.gov.ro, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administrația Fluvială a Dunării de Jos Galați. These maps contain data usable for navigation. The maps were made following own measurements along the entire length of the Danube. The fairway - the navigable part of the Danube is highlighted. Coverage: Administrația Fluvială a Dunării de Jos Galați. The portal shows the English title as "Electronic Navigation Maps" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Administrația Fluvială a Dunării de Jos Galați. Its keywords include ENC Hărți Electronice de Navigație. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-03-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ro.
